description:
JSPrintManager for Blazor allows you to perform Client-side Printing & Scanning from any Blazor WebAssembly or Blazor Server projects!
By writing pure .NET code, JSPrintManager for Blazor allows you to easily send raw data, text and native commands as well as known file formats (like PDF, TXT, DOC, XLS, JPG, PNG) to any printer installed or available at the client machine without showing or displaying any print dialog box!
JSPrintManager for Blazor does support any kind of type and brand printers! Thermal Label Barcode printers, POS receipt printers, RFID printers, Dot-Matrix printers, Kiosk printers, ID Card printers, Laser, Inkjet and more...
Printers Connectivity support includes: installed Windows printers (for USB connection), Shared Printers on the client machine network with a UNC name/path, printers connected to Parallel Port (e.g. LPT1) Centronics or Serial Port RS-232 (e.g. COM1) or Bluetooth as well as IP/Ethernet Network printers.
Send any Printer Command Language! Most known like ESC/P, PCL, PostScript, PRN, ZPL, EPL, IPL, DPL, EZPL, ZGL, SBPL, RCL WPL, CLP, IBM Proprinter, CPL, Dymo ESC codes, SPL, TCPL, TSPL-EZ, DASCOM, and more. USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL shipping labels formats too.
releaseNotes:
• New! New JSPMWSStatus.SslModeMismatch = 7 status. It's reported when the client's SSL mode (ws:// vs wss://) doesn't match the Client App's "Use SSL" setting.
• New! New CloseReason property (WSCloseReason: Code, WasConnected, Detail). It explains why the connection was closed or couldn't be established.
• New! New ClientAppVersion property. It holds the Client App version reported during the handshake.
• New! License validation support: new OnLicenseValidated event, LicenseState property (LicenseValidationState enum: Pending, Valid, Invalid, Timeout), IsLicenseValid property and WhenLicensed(int timeoutMs = 0) method.
• New! New ConnectTimeoutMs and LicenseTimeoutMs properties, both 10000 ms by default. Set them before calling Start().
• New! Fast lane, a secondary connection for printer queries: new StartFastLane(int timeoutMs = 15000) method that reuses the SSL mode, IP address and port from Start(), a StartFastLane(bool useSecureWS, string ipAddress, int port, int timeoutMs) overload, and a GetFastLaneStatus() method.
• New! New useFastLane parameter (default true) on GetPrinters, TryGetPrinters, GetPrintersInfo and TryGetPrintersInfo.
• New! New spoolerOnly parameter (default false) on GetPrintersInfo and TryGetPrintersInfo.
• New! New SetStatusInfo JSInvokable callback. It delivers the status, client app version, license state and close reason in a single call.
• Improved! Print jobs, scan jobs, IPP messages and TCP/Serial/BT/USB/HID comms are held while the license is being validated, then sent once validation finishes.
• Improved! CertificateError now comes with a clearer detail message when the Client App may have SSL disabled.
• Improved! Start() now reconnects if the previous attempt ended in NotInstalled, CertificateError, ConnectionError or SslModeMismatch. This lets you call Start(useSecureWS: false) after a SslModeMismatch.
• Improved! Stop() now sets the status to Closed, raises OnStatusChanged, and also closes the fast lane.
• Improved! GetClientAppInfo and GetClientAppInstances now use the same SSL mode and host as Start(). Before, they always used wss://localhost, which failed when the Client App had SSL disabled.
• Improved! Events from a connection that was already stopped or replaced are now ignored, so they can't overwrite the current status.
• Improved! A failed start() no longer leaves unhandled promise rejections in the console.
• Fixed! TryGetClientAppInfo(port) and TryGetClientAppInstances(port) ignored the port parameter.
• Fixed! SendIppMessage (the non-Try version) always threw an error. 
• Fixed! getClientAppInfo didn't pass the SSL mode, host or port on to getWorkerInstance. 
• Fixed! After Stop(), the status used to stay Open because the status handler failed when WS was null.
